CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_learning_private.observe_policy_decision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 insert into icash_learning_private.policy_cohorts(domain,context,market,policy_version,latest_decision_id) values(new.domain,new.context,new.market,new.policy_version,new.id)
 on conflict(domain,context,market,policy_version) do update set latest_decision_id=greatest(icash_learning_private.policy_cohorts.latest_decision_id,excluded.latest_decision_id);
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_review_learning_operations()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare a jsonb;b jsonb;begin a:=public.icash_review_operations_before_cohorts();b:=public.icash_review_policy_cohorts();perform public.icash_review_operation_deadlines();if (b->>'errors')::integer>0 then update icash_learning_private.components set last_error_at=now(),last_error_code='P0001' where component='review';end if;return a||jsonb_build_object('policyCohorts',b);end $function$
